title: Radha and the Skyshroud Rift
summary: Radha's connection to a damaged landscape makes her central to rift research and a target of dangerous plans.
narrative: Radha's Keldon and elven heritage placed her amid the Skyshroud crisis, where her unusual access to rift mana drew Teferi's attention.
Her resistance to being used as a magical tool foreshadowed the conflict over Jeska's later attempts to close rifts.
